claim: Every union-closed family F of distinct subsets of a seven-element universe containing empty set and the exact triple {0,1,2}, for which each of 0,1,2 belongs to STRICTLY fewer than half of F, has at least 19 members.
boundary: Fixed seven-element, triple-local strengthening only; NOT Frankl's original conjecture, NOT general ground-set bound, NOT verified novel or independently specialist accepted.
proof_structure: Singleton/pair injection lemma excludes six proper nonempty subsets of T in ANY hypothetical triple-local counterexample.
One CNF with 17 selectors covers all sizes k=2..18 exactly, not just k=18.
A DRAT proof refutes the CNF; drat-trim revalidates all reductions and produces an LRAT trace; lrat-check validates that trace.
Published van der Hout-Roos 19-set witness independently verifies the matching upper bound.

checker.note: External proof checker validation is not independent specialist acceptance; see docs.

prior_art.scope_gap: Community submission claims 19 under a minimum-cardinality triple assumption. This candidate omits that assumption but fixes the universe at seven; novelty and generality comparisons remain unreviewed.
